name: Ray-marching reference (min-max octree accelerated)
aliases: Knoll et al. octree ray tracing
Interactive Isosurface Ray Tracing (Knoll et al.)
definition: Accelerated direct isosurface visualization technique using a min-max octree for empty space skipping, serving as a performance baseline.
summary: This accelerated isosurface visualization technique uses a min-max octree to skip empty space during ray marching, offering low memory overhead and broad applicability to scalar volumes.
